info.title: Client Accounts
info.description: The Client Accounts API allows you to create, manage and retrieve information about client accounts.

post.description: Use this endpoint to create a new individual client account. If Flinks, Plaid or Mx credentials are provided, we will fetch all personal and bank account details from those providers.

ClientAccountID.description: Custom ID of the client account you want to create

EmailAddress.description: Client's email address - Must be a valid email

Province.description: Client's province specified using two character abbreviations (eg. BC, AB)

Country.description: Client's country specified using full country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. If not provided, we will default to the VoPay account's country.

Nationality.description: Client's nationality specified using full country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code.

Currency.description: 3-character currency code defined by the ISO-4217 standard (e.g. CAD, USD). Used to set the default currency used by this client account. Can be CAD or USD for Canadian accounts. Must be set to USD for US accounts.

PhoneNumber.description: Client's phone number. Digits only - no parentheses or dashes allowed.

DOB.description: Date of Birth, in date format YYYY-MM-DD (ex: 1960-01-15).

SINLastDigits.description: Last four digits of the client's SIN number.

Token.description: An iQ11 Token that has been generated using Custom Iframe.

Label.description: This option will add a Label to the client account. If the Label doesn't exist it will be created and applied.

FlinksAccountID.description: Flinks Account ID. Must be accompanied by a FlinksLoginID. VoPay will fetch the associated user and bank account details from Flinks.

FlinksLoginID.description: Flinks Login ID. Must be accompanied by a FlinksAccountID. VoPay will fetch the associated user and bank account details from Flinks.

PlaidProcessorToken.description: Plaid Processor Token. VoPay will fetch the associated user bank account details from Plaid.

MxProcessorToken.description: Mx Processor Token. VoPay will fetch the associated user bank account details from Mx.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

Status.description: The status of the newly created client account.

ClientAccountID.description: This ID should be saved as it is required in order to perform other actions using the client account such as creating new transactions.

VerifcationLink.description: A link to verify the newly created client account if applicable.

post.description: Use this endpoint to create a new business client account. If Flinks, Plaid or Mx credentials are provided, we will fetch all business and bank account details from those providers.

ClientAccountID.description: Custom ID of the client account you want to create

EmailAddress.description: Client's email address - Must be a valid email

Province.description: Client's province specified using two character abbreviations (eg. BC, AB)

Country.description: Client's country specified using full country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. If not provided, we will default to the VoPay account's country.

Nationality.description: Client's nationality specified using full country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code.

Currency.description: 3-character currency code defined by the ISO-4217 standard (e.g. CAD, USD). Used to set the default currency used by this client account. Can be CAD or USD for Canadian accounts. Must be set to USD for US accounts.

BusinessNumber.description: Company registration number. A 9-digit number that is unique to a business or legal entity.

BusinessTypeID.description: ID that represents the company's industry classification. See /account/business-types endpoint for more information.

BusinessTypeCategoryID.description: ID that indicates the company's category classification. See /account/business-types endpoint for more information.

BusinessWebsite.description: Company's website URL. It must be a valid URL and the protocol must be included (http or https).

BusinessPhone.description: Company's phone number. Digits only - no parentheses or dashes allowed.

IdentificationNumber.description: Client's federal tax ID. Digits only - no parentheses or dashes allowed.

Token.description: An iQ11 Token that has been generated using Custom Iframe.

Label.description: This option will add a Label to the client account. If the Label doesn't exist it will be created and applied.

FlinksAccountID.description: Flinks Account ID. Must be accompanied by a FlinksLoginID. VoPay will fetch the associated user and bank account details from Flinks.

FlinksLoginID.description: Flinks Login ID. Must be accompanied by a FlinksAccountID. VoPay will fetch the associated user and bank account details from Flinks.

PlaidProcessorToken.description: Plaid Processor Token. VoPay will fetch the associated user bank account details from Plaid.

MxProcessorToken.description: Mx Processor Token. VoPay will fetch the associated user bank account details from Mx.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

ClientAccountID.description: This ID should be saved as it is required in order to perform other actions using the client account such as creating new transactions.

get.description:
This endpoint returns a list of the available client accounts and some of its details.

It is also possible to filter the list of client accounts by ClientAccountID, its status (active or inactive), and client type (business, individual, receive-only).

parameters.name: ClientType
parameters.description: Type of account to be filtered. Use either 'individual', 'business' or 'receive-only'

parameters.name: AccountStatus
parameters.description: Filter by account status. Use true for active accounts and false for inactive.

parameters.name: ClientAccountID
parameters.description: Filter by the Client account ID

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Limit the number of records that are returned.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Use this parameter to set the starting point in the dataset.

parameters.name: SearchText
parameters.description: A text string to search for in the email addresses, names and business number.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

ClientAccountID.description: Client Account ID of the client account

ClientName.description: First and last name of the client

DOB.description: Date of Birth, in date format YYYY-MM-DD (ex: 1960-01-15)

SINLastDigits.description: Last four digits of the client's SIN number

IsActive.description: Flag that indicates whether the account is active or not

Province.description: Client Account's province specified using two character abbreviation (eg. BC, AB)

Country.description: Client Account's country specified using full country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code

IdentificationNumber.description: Client's ID (driver's licence or federal tax ID)

ParentAccountID.description: Account ID of the account that created the client account

Balances.description: Collection of Balances per available currency for the client account

Balance.description: The total balnace for the currency

PendingBalance.description: The pending balance for the currency

Labels.description: Collection of Labels associated with the client account

LabelID.description: The ID of the label value

TotalRecords.description: Total number of client account records in that search range.

Offset.description: Use this parameter to set the starting point in the dataset.

Limit.description: Limit the number of records that are returned.

get.description: This endpoint returns details on the current account balance and available funds for the given Client account.

parameters.name: ClientAccountID
parameters.description: Client account ID of customer who's balance you want to retrieve

parameters.name: Currency
parameters.description: 3 character currency code for the currency to fetch transactions for. If this is not specified it will be defaulted to the account's local currency (generally CAD).

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

AccountBalance.description: Indicates the total current account balance, including pending funds.

PendingFunds.description: Indicates the portion of the account balance which is pending due to in-progress transactions.

Reserve.description: Indicates the portion of the account balance which is being held as a reserve against returned or fraudulent transactions.

RollingReserveNSF.description: Indicates the portion of the account balance which is being held as a reserve against NSF transactions.

RollingReserveReturns.description: Indicates the portion of the account balance which is being held as a reserve against returned transactions.

AvailableFunds.description: Indicates the portion of the account balance which is currently available for use. This is calculated by taking the AccountBalance and subtracting the PendingFunds and Reserve amounts.

OffbookBalance.description: Indicates the portion of the account balance which is being held in an off-book account.

Currency.description: 3 character currency code for the balance being returned.

Wallets.description: Breakdown of balances by wallet. Each wallet is an object with its own balances.

RollingReserveNSF.description: NSF rolling reserve for the wallet.

RollingReserveReturns.description: Returns rolling reserve for the wallet.

post.description: Use this endpoint to generate a unique URL to onboard a new client account. To send an email containing the URL to the recipient, set SendEmail = true, and provide both the email address and full name of the recipient.

ClientType.description: Type of client account you want to onboard. Options are individual, business, standard and receive-only.

FirstName.description: Client's first name. Required if BusinessName is not provided.

LastName.description: Client's last name. Required if BusinessName is not provided.

BusinessName.description: Client's business name. Required if FirstName and LastName are not provided.

SendEmail.description: This option is used to send the onboarding link through email. If you wish to send an email, then provide true. The default value is false.

ReceiverEmailAddress.description: Recipient's email address. Required if SendEmail = true.

SendSMS.description: This option is used to send the onboarding link through SMS. If you wish to send an SMS, then provide true. The default value is false.

ReceiverPhoneNumber.description: Recipient's phone number. Required if SendSMS = true.

Label.description: This option will add a Label to the client account. If the Label doesn't exist it will be created and applied.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

OnboardingLink.description: The url of the onboarding link.

post.description: This endpoint will transfer money directly from the debitor client account to the recipient client account. Both client accounts must be active.

DebitorClientAccountID.description: ID of the client account transferring the funds

RecipientClientAccountID.description: ID of the client account receiving the funds

Amount.description: The amount to transfer from the debitor client account to the recipient client account.

Currency.description: 3 character currency code for the currency. If this is not specified the transaction will use the account's local currency.

ClientReferenceNumber.description: An optional reference number to associate with the transaction

Notes.description: An optional note to associate with the transaction.

IdempotencyKey.description: A unique key to prevent duplicate transactions. If a previous request with the same idempotency key was successful, the current request will return the same response as the previous successful request.

ParentTransactionID.description: If this transaction is related to a previous transaction, specify the parent transaction ID here.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

TransactionID.description: The unique ID of the transaction that was just created. This ID should be saved as it is required in order to look up the status information on the transaction.

post.description:
This endpoint will fund the Debitor client account using their default bank account, and then trigger an account transfer to the recipient client account once the funds have been cleared. 

To set a default bank account, please use the /bank-account/set-my-bank-account endpoint.

DebitorClientAccountID.description: ID of the client account transferring the funds

RecipientClientAccountID.description: ID of the client account receiving the funds

RecipientClientAccountIDSplit.description: A JSON formatted string specifying the details for a split payment. This must fit to the following format where the amount identifier is either Amount or Percentage, [{"ClientAccountID":"client_account_id_1","Amount": "5"},{"ClientAccountID":"client_account_id_2","Amount": "10"}]

Amount.description: The amount to debit from the customer's bank account.

FundingRail.description: Specifies the rail to use for the funding transaction. If this is not specified eft will be used for Canadian accounts and ach for US accounts.

IdempotencyKey.description: A unique key to prevent duplicate transactions. If a previous request with the same idempotency key was successful, the current request will return the same response as the previous successful request.

Currency.description: 3 character currency code for the currency. If this is not specified the transaction will use the account's local currency.

ReverseOnFailure.description: Setting this to true will reverse both the fund and transfer should either fail. This is set to false, by default.

ClientReferenceNumber.description: An optional reference number to associate with the transactions

Notes.description: An optional note to associate with the transactions.

TransactionLabel.description: The TransactionLabel overrides the originator short name on statements

GLCode.description: An optional unique identification general ledger code.

WalletID.description: The ID of the wallet to associate with the funding transaction. Requires DebitorClientAccountID to be provided.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

FundingTransactionID.description: The unique ID of the funding transaction that was just created. This ID should be saved as it is required order to look up the status information on the transaction.

AccountTransferID.description: The unique ID of the account transfer that was just created. This ID should be saved as it is required order to look up the status information on the transaction.

post.description:
This endpoint will transfer money from the debitor client account to the recipient client account, and then immediately withdraw the money from the recipient client account into their default bank account. 

To set a default bank account, please use the /bank-account/set-my-bank-account endpoint.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

WithdrawTransactionID.description: The unique ID of the withdrawal transaction that was just created. This ID should be saved as it is required order to look up the status information on the transaction.

AccountTransferID.description: The unique ID of the account transfer that was just created. This ID should be saved as it is required order to look up the status information on the transaction.

post.description:
This endpoint will fund the debitor client account using their default bank account, and then transfer the money to the recipient client account once the funds have been cleared. Once the funds are transferred, a withdraw transaction will be triggered to send the funds to the recipient client account's default bank account. 

To set a default bank account, please use the /bank-account/set-my-bank-account endpoint.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

FundingTransactionID.description: The unique ID of the funding transaction that was just created. This ID should be saved as it is required order to look up the status information on the transaction.

WithdrawTransactionID.description: The unique ID of the withdrawal transaction that was just created. This ID should be saved as it is required order to look up the status information on the transaction.

AccountTransferID.description: The unique ID of the account transfer that was just created. This ID should be saved as it is required order to look up the status information on the transaction.

get.description: This endpoint returns a list all of the transactions which affect the account balance. This endpoint only returns basic information on the transactions. More detailed information on individual transactions is available from other API endpoints.

parameters.name: StartDateTime
parameters.description: Return transactions that occurred on or after this date/time. Can be specified in either YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS or YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: EndDateTime
parameters.description: Return transactions that occurred on or before this date/time. Can be specified in either YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS or YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: ClientAccountID
parameters.description: Filter transactions by Client account ID

parameters.name: Currency
parameters.description: 3 character currency code for the currency to fetch transactions for. If this is not specified it will be defaulted to the account's local currency (generally CAD).

parameters.name: TransactionType
parameters.description: Specifies the type of transaction to return. Accepted values are: 'EFT Funding', 'EFT Withdrawal', 'Interac Money Request', 'Interac Bulk Payout', 'Credit Card', 'Fee', 'Reversal'.

parameters.name: TransactionID
parameters.description: Searches for a transaction with the specified transaction ID, including any related child transactions which may exist.

parameters.name: ClientReferenceNumber
parameters.description: Searches for transactions with the specified client reference number.

parameters.name: ScheduledTransactionID
parameters.description: Id of the schedule transaction to search

parameters.name: WalletID
parameters.description: Id of the wallet that the transactions should belong to

parameters.name: IsFlagged
parameters.description: Filter the list of transactions to only include transactions that have a flag status and have not been confirmed by the client.

parameters.name: IsRefunded
parameters.description: Filter the list of transactions to only include transactions that have been refunded.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

NumberOfRecords.description: Total number of transaction records returned

TransactionDateTime.description: The timestamp on which the transaction occurred.

TransactionType.description: Specifies the type of transaction, for example 'EFT Funding', 'EFT Withdrawal', 'Fee'.

Notes.description: If applicable, notes giving context to the transaction.

DebitAmount.description: The dollar amount by which this transaction debited funds from your account balance. If DebitAmountis set, CreditAmount will be null.

CreditAmount.description: The dollar amount by which this transaction credited funds to your account balance. If CreditAmount is set, DebitAmount will be null.

HoldAmount.description: The dollar amount of the funds from this transaction which are temporarily on hold. This is only applicable for transactions where CreditAmount is set.

LastModified.description: This timestamp indicates when the transaction record was last modified. In normal circumstances the transaction record will only be modified when the HoldAmount is changed.

ParentTransactionID.description: If a transaction directly relates to another transaction, this value will be set to link the new transaction to its parent. For example if an EFT comes back with insufficient funds a new transaction will be created referencing the original transaction as its parent.

ChildTransactionIDs.description: If this transaction directly relates to any other transactions this will contain a collection of child transaction IDs. For example if an EFT is reversed due to insufficient funds the original transaction record will reference the new transaction as a child.

ClientReferenceNumber.description: The optional reference number which was set when the transaction was created.

WalletID.description: ID of the wallet this transaction belongs to

ClientAccountID.description: Client account ID used on the transaction, if applicable

TransactionErrorCode.description: Error code of the transaction, if applicable

TransactionFailureReason.description: Failure reason of the transaction, if applicable

TransactionFlag.description: Flag status of the transaction, if applicable

ELinxRequestID.description: The unique ID of the eLinx request attached to the transaction, if applicable

IsRefunded.description: True if the transaction was refunded, false if it is not

post.description: This endpoint is used to schedule a fund-transfer between two client accounts.

DebitorClientAccountID.description: ID of the client account transferring the funds

RecipientClientAccountID.description: ID of the client account receiving the funds

RecipientClientAccountIDSplit.description: A JSON formatted string specifying the details for a split payment. This must fit to the following format where the amount identifier is either Amount or Percentage, [{"ClientAccountID":"client_account_id_1","Amount": "5"},{"ClientAccountID":"client_account_id_2","Amount": "10"}]

Amount.description: The amount to debit from the customer's bank account.

Currency.description: 3 character currency code for the currency. If this is not specified the transaction will use the account's local currency.

FundingRail.description: Specifies the rail to use for the funding transaction. If this is not specified eft will be used for Canadian accounts and ach for US accounts.

ReverseOnFailure.description: Setting this to true will reverse both the fund and transfer should either fail. This is set to false, by default.

ClientReferenceNumber.description: An optional reference number to associate with the transfers

Notes.description: An optional note to associate with the transfers.

TransactionLabel.description: The TransactionLabel overrides the originator short name on statements

Frequency.description: The frequency of the scheduled transfer. Valid options are: single, weekly, monthly, semi-monthly, and yearly.

ScheduleStartDate.description: Date from which the schedule will be started

ScheduleEndDate.description: Date when the transfer processing will end (Only for recurring frequencies), Either provide ScheduleEndDate or EndingAfterPayments

EndingAfterPayments.description: Number of payments after which the transfer processing will end (Only for recurring frequencies), Either provide ScheduleEndDate or EndingAfterPayments

SemiMonthlyFrequencyType.description: Type of semi-monthly frequency. This field is only required when Frequency is set to semi-monthly. The possible values are: SemiMonthFirstAndFifteenth, SemiMonthFifteenthAndLast

GLCode.description: An optional unique identification general ledger code.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

ScheduledTransferID.description: The unique ID of the scheduled transfer that was just created. This ID should be saved as it is required order to look up the status information on the scheduled transfer.

post.description: This endpoint is used to schedule a transfer-withdraw between two client accounts.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

ScheduledTransferID.description: The unique ID of the scheduled transfer that was just created. This ID should be saved as it is required order to look up the status information on the scheduled transfer.

post.description: This endpoint is used to schedule a fund-transfer-withdraw between two client accounts.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

ScheduledTransferID.description: The unique ID of the scheduled transfer that was just created. This ID should be saved as it is required order to look up the status information on the scheduled transfer.

post.description: This endpoint is used to cancel a scheduled client account transfer and all remaining payments belonging to that scheduled transfer. Only scheduled transfers with the status in progress can be cancelled.

ScheduledTransferID.description: ID of the schedule transfer to cancel

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

Status.description: A message indicating the resulting scheduled transfer status.

get.description:
This endpoint is used to look up either the list of all scheduled client account transfers, or to list the details of a single scheduled client account transfer. 

 If the value ScheduledTransferID is present, we only list the details of that scheduled client account transfer.

parameters.name: ScheduledTransferID
parameters.description: ID of the schedule transfer (if this value is present, we list the details of the scheduled tranfser)

parameters.name: ClientAccountID
parameters.description: The Client Account ID that the scheduled transactions belong to

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: Return Client account transfers scheduled for or after this date/time. Can be specified in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description: Return Client account transfers scheduled for or before this date/time. Can be specified in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Success.description: True if the request was successful, false if it failed

ErrorMessage.description: Contains a description of the error if the request failed

ScheduledClientAccountTransfers.description: Collection of scheduled transfer info data

ID.description: Unique ID for the scheduled transfer

RecipientClientAccountIDSplit.description: The split details for the recipient client accounts

Amount.description: The amount of the scheduled transaction

TransferType.description: The payment type of scheduled transfer; i.e., fund-transfer, transfer-withdraw or fund-transfer-withdraw

ReverseOnFailure.description: Instructions on whether or not the scheduled transfer should be reversed if it fails

Frequency.description: The frequency of the schedule transfer: single, weekly, monthly, semi-monthly, annual

SemiMonthlyFrequencyType.description: The semi-monthly frequency type, if applicable.

ClientReferenceNumber.description: An optional reference number which was associated with the transfers.

Notes.description: An optional note which was associated with the transfers.

TransactionLabel.description: An optional transaction label which was associated with the transfers.

ScheduleStartDate.description: Date from which the transfer(s) will be started

ScheduleEndDate.description: Date from which the transfers will end

EndingAfterPayments.description: Number of payments after which the transfer processing will end

Status.description: A message indicating the current transaction status. Statuses are: cancelled, completed, or in progress

DateAdded.description: Date the schedule transfer was added

UpcomingTransfers.description: Upcoming transfer listing (This option only will be available if the user provides ScheduledTransferID as a parameter)

ScheduledTransferID.description: Scheduled Transfer ID for upcoming transaction

TransferDate.description: Date when the transfer will get created
